llm.summary: This skill is a documentation-only modeling helper that reads project context to produce state, data-flow, and service-dependency models, with no evidence of unsafe behavior.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and artifact content consistently focus on domain modeling, state transitions, data-flow tables, and service dependency diagrams for QA/business analysis.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The activation terms include broad phrases such as modeling and complex business process analysis, so it may trigger more often than necessary, but the resulting instructions remain aligned with modeling work.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains a single SKILL.md file and no executable scripts, install hooks, or hidden runtime components.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Allowed tools are limited to Read, Grep, and Glob, which are proportionate for inspecting requirements or scenario documents needed for modeling.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background execution, privilege escalation, credential handling, network calls, file mutation, or destructive behavior is present in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Installers should expect this skill to read relevant local requirement or scenario files when invoked and produce modeling tables or diagrams. Its triggers could be narrower, so users may want to invoke it explicitly for domain-modeling tasks rather than relying on automatic activation.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger language is real, but it is tied to the skill's modeling purpose and does not introduce high-impact authority or hidden behavior; treat it as a usability/scoping note rather than a security concern.
